# Vendors

Representative companies (ownership changes often; re-verify).

# Concepts

* [Datavant](/service-providers/vendors/datavant.md) - Patient tokenisation and data-linking network.
* [IntegriChain](/service-providers/vendors/integrichain.md) - Channel data management (867/852/SP aggregation), contracting and GTN platforms.
* [IQVIA](/service-providers/vendors/iqvia.md) - Largest provider of pharma data (Xponent, NPA, DDD, LAAD, OneKey), analytics, CRO and CSO services.
* [Komodo Health](/service-providers/vendors/komodo-health.md) - Healthcare data and analytics company whose Healthcare Map links open and closed claims for 330M+ patients.
* [MMIT](/service-providers/vendors/mmit.md) - Formulary, policy and payer-lives data.
* [Surescripts](/service-providers/vendors/surescripts.md) - Dominant US e-prescribing network (eRx, EPCS, RTPB, medication history, ePA).
* [Symphony Health (ICON)](/service-providers/vendors/symphony-health.md) - Rx and claims data provider owned by ICON.
* [Veeva Systems](/service-providers/vendors/veeva.md) - CRM, OpenData/Network MDM and Vault applications for life sciences.
